The Teehee.dev API provides a simple way to retrieve random jokes curated by Jesse G. Donat. Users can make a GET request to receive a joke along with its ID, question, answer, and a permalink for reference. All jokes are in Question/Answer format and are universally safe for work and generally family friendly.
